title: PackageRegistry
description: Unified single source of truth for FOSS package-manager identity (name/coordinates/owner) across all registries in actual use (pypi, nuget, maven, npm, go_modules, cargo). Consolidates data/foss_packages.json (Maven-only) and data/cargo_packages.json (Cargo-only) per Mission MT015-2026-07-30-PACKAGE-REGISTRY. vcpkg and Conan are deliberately excluded -- confirmed never implemented in practice; C++ ships via NuGet under its own package ID distinct from .NET's. Keyed {family}.{platform}, one entry per product. Machine-written only: `candidate`/`scouted_at` populated by scout-time extraction (package_manifest.py), `verification`/`owner_match` populated by a live registry check (a scheduled watcher or a publish skill). Never hand-edit `verification.published`/`verification.verified_owner` without independent live evidence.

PlatformMap.description: Maps platform (e.g. 'java', 'net', 'python') to its PackageEntry for this family.

registry_type.description: Which package-manager ecosystem this entry targets. vcpkg/conan are not valid values -- never implemented in practice.

candidate.description: Registry-appropriate coordinate shape. Discriminated by registry_type.

oneOf.description: pypi, nuget, npm, cargo -- flat name/package_id

candidate_owner.description: Expected publisher org/namespace (e.g. 'org.aspose', 'asposefoss'). Null if not yet determined.

scouted_at.description: When package_manifest.py extraction populated `candidate`. Null if never scouted.

verified_owner.description: Publisher org/namespace actually observed live on the registry. Null until a live check succeeds.

evidence_note.description: Free-text evidence description, mirroring foss_packages.json's confirmed_evidence field.

consecutive_checks_agreeing.description: Debounce counter -- a watcher must not flip published:false->true until this reaches 2, to avoid flapping on transient API errors.

owner_match.description: verification.verified_owner == candidate_owner. Null until verification.published is true and an owner check has actually run -- distinct from false (checked and mismatched).
